description: This file defines a data transfer object class MembershipSearchFilterParams used for filtering membership search results in the OrangeHRM application. It extends a base FilterParams class and sets a default sort field.

classes.name: MembershipSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for encapsulating filter parameters for membership search, including allowed sort fields and default sort ordering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of MembershipSearchFilterParams and sets the default sort field to 'm.name'.
